summary: Enhance your expertise in energy transition and sustainability with our comprehensive training course tailored for the oil and gas sector.
lede: Sustainability and energy transition training explains how the shift to lower-carbon energy affects oil and gas. It is for industry and related-sector professionals who need to assess transition challenges and contribute to organizational sustainability planning. Participants explore climate and transition risks, emissions measurement and reduction, renewable energy integration, and ways to incorporate ESG into decisions and sustainability reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals in the oil and gas industry, as well as associated sectors that influence or are influenced by the energy transition, including:
audience: Investment and finance professionals in energy firms
modules: Sustainability and ESG Fundamentals in Energy
Renewable Energy Integration in Oil and Gas
Leading Change and Building a Sustainable Culture
